item.title: Am I Dating a Sociopath? 9 Early Warning Signs You Shouldn't Ignore
item.description: If you are asking, “Am I dating a sociopath?” the primary indicators include a consistent pattern of deceit, a chilling lack of empathy, impulsive rule-breaking, and the use of superficial charm to exploit you.
